description: Return the list of LLM-as-judge evaluation criteria. Includes the 5 global defaults (helpfulness / accuracy / relevance / safety / conciseness) plus the custom criteria created in your account. Each criterion has id / name / rubric (the instruction text for the judge) / scaleMin / scaleMax. Use before running an eval to see which axes are available. The Free plan can read all criteria (creating custom ones is Pro+ only, but existing rows stay visible after downgrade).
name: list_eval_criteria
